baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction لِتُنذِرَ terminates in the causal state فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Warning names feared danger so that caution wakes; it addresses a human collective whose paternal line did not perform that awakening.

activation_trace.role: Danger-announcement that awakens caution supplies the verse's initiating action.
A human collective is the social body to be awakened.
Paternity and formative nurture make the missing warning an inherited educational gap.
Being outside vigilance is the state the warning is meant to interrupt.

changed_reading.before: The verse commissions delivery of information to an uninformed people.
changed_reading.after: The verse commissions an alarm that should move an inherited state of non-vigilance into active caution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence مَا أُنذِرَ ءَابَاؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ joins ancestral non-warning directly to present heedlessness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The unmarked-road branch of heedlessness turns the paternal line into a route lacking signs; warning places an orienting marker into that route.

activation_trace.role: A road or tract without a marker materializes inherited heedlessness as failed orientation.
The formative paternal chain is the route along which orientation failed to travel.
Straightness and right orientation supply the condition the newly marked route could recover.
The warning functions as the missing danger-marker.

changed_reading.before: The ancestors simply lacked an earlier notice.
changed_reading.after: The present address marks and reorients a lineage whose inherited route carried no usable danger-sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ن ذ ر root in تُنذِرَ and أُنذِرَ can retain a distant branch of self-binding obligation beneath the ordinary warning sense.
baseline_models.mechanism: The warning does more than alert: once heard, it makes responsibility binding for a collective whose formative caretakers had not established it.

activation_trace.role: Voluntarily incurred obligation contributes the exploratory image of warning making accountability binding.
Guardianship and care frame the collective as a responsibility-bearing social body.
Failed paternal formation explains why the obligation had not become socially operative.

changed_reading.before: Warning reports a danger that the audience may accept or ignore.
changed_reading.after: Warning is also a summons after which the audience can no longer claim to remain unbound by responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Neck-restraint fixes posture, barriers close front and rear, and a covering defeats sight; heedlessness becomes an embodied enclosure of orientation rather than a mere shortage of information.

activation_trace.role: Non-vigilance is the focus state now given an embodied mechanism.
A collar that binds an organ supplies the fixed bodily posture of the enclosure.
Closing gaps on both sides blocks spatial and temporal orientation.
An overlying cover supplies the immediate obstruction of perception.
Heart-sight extends the failed seeing from optics to inward discernment.

structural_cues: 36:8-9 accumulate neck, front, rear, cover, and sight constraints immediately after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraints and blocked perception; I infer that they cause or stabilize the focus-state. A live alternative is that they depict the consequence, not the cause, of heedlessness.

changed_reading.before: The people are inattentive because no warning reached their ancestors.
changed_reading.after: The warning confronts a socially inherited sensorium whose posture, route, and inward sight have become closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated warning is ineffective for one audience yet reaches the one who follows remembrance and fears the unseen, whereupon warning opens into good news; the closing formula names that receptor as whoever is alive.

activation_trace.role: The focus warning provides the signal whose reception is being tested.
Warning and non-warning becoming equal establishes failed reception rather than absent transmission.
Following behind supplies the responsive movement that distinguishes a receptor.
Recollection after absence makes warning a reactivation of retained capacity.
Fear with awe is the inward caution actually awakened.
News that opens the face with joy shows warning changing valence in a responsive hearer.
The returned purpose clause closes the whole-surah test of warning.
The living being supplies the final name for warning-capable receptivity.

structural_cues: 36:10-11 contrast indiscriminate delivery with restrictive reception.
36:70 repeats the warning-purpose construction and pairs it with life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equalized warning, selective following, remembrance, fear, good news, and life; I infer that warning diagnoses and activates responsiveness. Alternatively, 'alive' may classify the audience without defining a reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The commission addresses a people defined by historical lack of warning.
changed_reading.after: The commission exposes who is functionally alive: warning becomes effective where remembrance can be followed and inward caution can move.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing, surviving traces, exhaustive counting, and a clear reference convert the focus warning from a momentary utterance into a durable marker inserted into an unmarked ancestral line.

activation_trace.role: The unmarked tract is the inherited condition to which durable traces answer.
The paternal line supplies the transmission axis on which a mark was missing.
Writing that fixes an operative ruling makes the warning consequential and durable.
A surviving sign supplies the transgenerational trace the focus lineage lacked.
Exhaustive enumeration prevents the warning and its aftermath from disappearing.
An origin, gathering point, and reference gives scattered traces a common orientation.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes the record readable as guidance.

structural_cues: 36:12 follows the warning/reception contrast with deeds, aftereffects, total enumeration, and a clear imam.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription and preserved effects; I infer that warning itself becomes a lineage-marker. A live alternative is that 36:12 records conduct only after warning and does not describe warning's transmission.

changed_reading.before: The warning fills a one-time informational absence.
changed_reading.after: The warning establishes a durable, readable trace where the ancestral route had carried no marker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The struck example sends messengers who deliver, then produces a local man who moves from the city's edge and calls his own people to follow; external warning generates an internal social carrier.

activation_trace.role: The focus alarm is the communicative action enacted by the example.
Making an example visible turns the following narrative into a functional test of the focus.
The explicit struck-example branch licenses transfer of the narrative mechanism back to 36:6.
Dispatch and movement initiate the warning from outside the community.
Delivery to the destination defines the messengers' bounded task.
Purposeful movement shows the message activating a new carrier inside the city.
The focus root's image of rising to an affair sharpens the local man's address to his people as social activation.
Following completes the relay by converting delivered warning into communal movement.

structural_cues: 36:14-17 move from dispatch to delivery, while 36:20 shifts agency to a man addressing يَا قَوْمِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an external mission followed by an internal advocate; I infer that the warning caused or enabled the local relay. Alternatively, the man may only endorse the messengers rather than become a second warner.

changed_reading.before: One commissioned warner speaks downward to a passive people.
changed_reading.after: Effective warning can reproduce within the people, causing one member to rise, cross social space, and carry the call to his own collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Waiting for the promised time is broken by one cry that removes the capacity to make a testament or return to family, before sleepers are raised; warning is the remaining interval in which transmission can still occur.

activation_trace.role: Paternal formation makes failed transmission the focus problem sharpened by the deadline.
The alarm occupies the actionable interval before sudden interruption.
A promise bounded by time supplies the disputed deadline.
Waiting and respite define the false sense of remaining time.
The terrifying single cry abruptly closes that interval.
A charge connected onward to another person is precisely what can no longer be transmitted.
The near group of belonging identifies the interrupted transmission destination.
Return to the prior home-state is denied when the deadline arrives.
Arousing the still from rest supplies the irreversible next phase.

structural_cues: 36:48-50 compress dispute, waiting, one cry, and loss of testament or family return.
36:51-52 immediately reverse stillness into compelled rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cutoff that prevents testament and family return; I infer that 36:6 repairs an intergenerational handoff while speech remains possible. The alternative is an exclusively individual deadline with no lineage emphasis.

changed_reading.before: An ancestral failure in the past explains present heedlessness.
changed_reading.after: The present warning is an urgent chance to stop the same failure from becoming another untransmitted generation before the handoff closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A preserved covenant addressed to Adam's children, directing worship onto a straight path, places the local paternal gap inside a larger human lineage; non-warning can be read as failed preservation of an older charge.

activation_trace.role: The paternal chain is the local transmission line being reconsidered.
A preserved covenant supplies an address older and wider than the local chain.
Filiation and descent make all children of Adam a transmission lineage.
Submissive worship states the covenant's negative command.
The straight road supplies the inherited orientation the focus lineage failed to retain.
The focus root's straightness branch binds the people to the stated straight path.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance identifies the capacity that should preserve the charge.

structural_cues: 36:60 directly addresses بني آدم with an earlier عهد.
36:61 repeats the straight-path phrase associated with the opening context.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a primordial filial covenant; I infer that the focus's ancestral gap may be a local rupture in preservation rather than total human non-address. The covenant and warning may instead be distinct addresses.

changed_reading.before: The clause means that the audience stands after an absolute ancestral absence of address.
changed_reading.after: One live reading is that their immediate paternal chain failed to preserve and reactivate an older human covenant, so the new warning repairs a lineage rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mouth-sealing transfers speech to hands and testimony to feet, while eyes, path, shape, and forward motion can be erased; warning supplies an external sign before the body itself becomes the compulsory record.

activation_trace.role: Leaving writing without marks gives heedlessness an inscriptional form.
A secured preventing seal closes voluntary oral response.
Intelligible speech transfers communicative agency from mouth to hand.
A witnessing mark makes bodily action legible as evidence.
Erasure of a trace supplies the threatened opposite of readable warning.
The straight path is present yet unusable when sight is erased.
Transformation of form threatens the stable bodily carrier itself.
Forward passage names the agency that can be removed while one remains in place.

structural_cues: 36:65-67 move consecutively from sealed speech to bodily witness, erased sight, and immobilized form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compulsory bodily evidence and possible erasure; I infer that prior warning is a voluntary pre-inscription that makes response possible. Alternatively, the judicial body-scene may confirm deeds without describing warning's mode.

changed_reading.before: Warning is an oral message offered to inattentive listeners.
changed_reading.after: Warning is the readable sign offered before voluntary speech closes and the addressee's own body is made to disclose the record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The visible disputant forgets his own creation, is redirected to first origination and re-creation of decayed bone, and finally to command becoming event; heedlessness is failed memory of evidence embodied in one's origin.

activation_trace.role: The focus non-vigilance is re-specified as self-forgetting.
Eye and insight make the person's own origin available as evidence.
Origination supplies evidence already embodied in the addressee.
Loss of remembered content explicitly states the operative form of heedlessness.
Decay supplies the apparent material limit that remembered origination overturns.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the repeatable originating act.
Firstness directs recollection to the evidentiary beginning.
Binding command supplies the decisive initiating direction.
A thing's saying as its indication links utterance to disclosed reality.
Occurrence and presence complete the movement from command to event.

structural_cues: 36:77-79 move from visible human origin through explicit forgetting to first creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies forgetting of creation; I infer that the focus warning works by reactivating evidence already borne in the self. Alternatively, the closing creation argument may answer resurrection-denial without redefining 36:6's heedlessness.

changed_reading.before: Heedlessness is inherited ignorance of an externally delivered message.
changed_reading.after: Heedlessness is also failure to retrieve one's own originating evidence, so warning functions as re-memory rather than mere addition of new data.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the wound-with-compensation branch is distant from ordinary verbal warning. It remains anchored in the doubled focus root and is activated by writing, surviving traces, exhaustive reckoning, recompense, and witness; downstream prose should present it only as a juridical-material analogy, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus occurrences of ن ذ ر carry a branch in which a wound has an obligatory assessed due.

activation_trace.role: A wound carrying a fixed due supplies the exploratory image of warning as notice of accountable injury.
Inscription that fixes a ruling gives the claimed liability a formal record.
A remaining mark lets the ancestral lesion persist as evidence.
Exact reckoning makes the due inspectable rather than vague.
Answering an act with its due supplies the eventual settlement.
A witnessing mark makes the liability evidentially present.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, warning also exposes an inherited lesion as an assessable claim whose trace, due, and witness can no longer remain hidden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain material analogy is surprising because warning is not literally combustion. It remains validly anchored to warning's awakening of heedlessness and to the exact green-tree/fire sequence; downstream prose should qualify it as an activation image for latent responsiveness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes caution-awakening warning to a state left outside vigilance.

activation_trace.role: Awakening caution supplies the latent activation to be imaged as ignition.
Non-vigilance is the apparently inactive state from which activation emerges.
Living receptivity connects the warned audience to the green material.
Interwoven supporting wood supplies the material carrier of latent fire.
Fresh green growth makes ignition materially counterintuitive.
Burning fire is the latent state disclosed from the green carrier.
Ignition completes the analogy of warning activating concealed capacity.

changed_reading.before: Warning adds a message to an inertly inattentive audience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, warning is ignition: it draws active caution from a living but apparently unreceptive substrate, as fire is kindled from green wood.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قَوْمًا ordinarily names a people, while the cited branch names an eye whose globe remains standing after sight is lost. Repeated failures and erasure of sight keep it anchored; downstream prose should render it as a severe collective image, never as the noun's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun قَوْمًا admits a remote branch image of an outwardly intact but sightless standing eye.

activation_trace.role: The standing eye with lost vision images a collective still present in form but null in perception.
Denied ocular seeing activates the sightless-eye image immediately after the focus.
Loss of light and sight intensifies the image from failed seeing to erased capacity.
The literal seeing eye resolves the remote focus branch into the surah's bodily vocabulary.
The repeated question of seeing confirms perception, not physical presence, as the failed function.

changed_reading.before: قَوْمًا identifies the collective receiving the warning.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the collective resembles a standing blind eye: socially intact and visibly present, yet unable to perform the perception its form promises.

strongest_changes: Heedlessness shifted from missing information to an embodied enclosure of posture, route, and inward sight.
Warning shifted from indiscriminate delivery to a test and activation of living receptivity that can reproduce as an internal social relay.
The ancestral gap shifted from static history to a repairable transmission failure under a deadline, with durable trace, covenant, and creation-memory as competing mechanisms.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converted the focus roots into mechanisms: an unmarked route becomes blocked and then inscribed, warning becomes relay and vitality-test, and inherited absence is pressured by interrupted testament, bodily witness, remembered origin, and latent fire.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ancestral non-warning denotes total historical absence or a local rupture in preserving an older covenant remains open.
Whether 'whoever is alive' defines functional responsiveness or only names the audience remains open.
Assessed liability, bodily pre-inscription, green ignition, and the standing blind eye are controlled analogical activations, not direct lexical substitutions.
